name: smwmusic-megami-tensei-gaiden-last-bible-ii-town-remix
title: Megami Tensei Gaiden: Last Bible II - Town (Remix)
description:
Last Bible II's Town theme, remixed using the SNES SDK samples for Super Famicompo 5's challenge category. (it actually won!)

One of many tracks from the earlier Last Bible games that has a lot of potential that goes unrealized due to being locked within 4 channels, so I decided to give it something of a glow-up. (Or glow-down, depending on your preferences. In any case, it's a re-imagining of sorts.)
